noveltyJustification: Prior work selected typed blocks and no forced scrolling; this iteration adds the concrete turn hierarchy, per-type collapse matrix, two-state live-edge behavior, stable return-anchor schema, and accessible error/announcement contract.
focus: Q3: Concrete mobile transcript hierarchy, collapse defaults, live-edge behavior, error and usage prominence, and safe return anchoring.

label: Group semantic blocks into turn-level reading units without flattening transcript types.
Expand messages, active plans, and errors; collapse thinking, successful tool detail, patches, and usage by default.
Pin streaming output only while following; preserve the visible block and count new blocks while paused.
Restore warm navigation with stable block ID, sequence fallback, local offset, and edge mode.
Keep unresolved errors outside the stream and coalesce polite assistive announcements.
Return anchors and route state contain no prompt, path, diff, tool input, or other transcript content.
Incoming output and submitted steers never force-scroll a reader who is paused above the live edge.
Current renderer exposes all block kinds as peer articles and collapses only thinking.
Current virtualized transcript has no following/paused state, unread-tail count, or jump control.

direction: Flatten typed blocks into chat bubbles
reason: Erases execution semantics needed to inspect plans, tools, diffs, errors, and usage.

direction: Force-scroll on every stream update or steer
reason: Destroys the operator's review position and makes long-running output unsteerable.

direction: Persist pixel-only or content-derived return anchors
reason: Variable-height virtualization makes pixels unstable and content-derived state violates redaction boundaries.
